<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex89022025-11-08-14-27" status="finalized"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4025"><abbr>slob dpon</abbr> gtsang drug</rs> na re de gnyis chos du ma'i rten yin min bye brag med do || 'di ni sgra mi rtag byas na chos can brjod pa'i sgra mi ldan rnams × gcod kyi sgra yin te | sgra la rtag pa rnam
        <lb n="28b6"/> par bcad pa tsam yin gyi sgra las gzhan mi rtag pa yin pa bsal ba med pa'i phyir ro || sgra'i mi rtag byas na chos brjod pa'i sgra gzhan ldan rnam gcod kyi ngag yin te sgra las gzhi gzhan gyi mi rtag pa bcad nas | sgra kho rang mi rtag pa go byed du byung pa'i phyir ro || de bzhin du
        <lb n="28b7"/> don la sbyor de ma thag pa dang 'dra ste | mi ldan × rnam gcod dang gzhan ldan rnam gcod gnyis ka ltar na yang de gnyis kyi tshogs don rtogs pa la khyad med do gsung ngo || 'di la tshogs don rtogs pa khyad med spyir dgag | so sor dgag go || dang po ni chos brjod pa dang chos can

     <pb n="29a"/>

        <lb n="29a1"/> brjod pa gang gis kyang tshogs don rtogs pa la khyad med pa'i phyir ro || rkyang pa brjod na ma tshogs pa'i ya gyal go ba med par thal lo || 'dod na des tshogs don rtogs pa'ang med par thal | ya gyal brjod nas go ba khegs pa'i phyir ro || ma nges na mi tsam med kyang
        <lb n="29a2"/> btsun pa yod ces bya'o || </seg></TEI>
source: 3_089_02 legs spyad nyi ma'i 'od zer mtshon cha'i rgyal po.xml
